findings.citation: DESIGN.md:134 "Warning …: In Progress, Awaiting approval, In Repair." and the amendment DESIGN.md:227 "a second, warning-toned `Badge` reading "Sent back": the mark that tells the Agent who needs correcting."
findings.note: The "Sent back" mark and "Awaiting approval" are identical amber pills, so the mark that says 'this needs you' reads like 'nothing to do'. Keep the label and tone; give the mark the existing IconAlertTriangle (h-3 w-3) in place of the dot, and amend DESIGN.md:134/:227 to name it.
